profile.name: Prior Lumen显微照明光源
profile.description: 用于显微成像系统的照明光源，驱动中主要提供光源开关与状态查询功能。代码说明其借用激光器界面控件进行操作，但实际对象更像是可开关的显微照明光源而非激光器。
profile.description_en: An illumination source used in a microscopy imaging system. The driver mainly provides on/off control and state query. The code notes that it pretends to be a laser only to reuse laser GUI controls, but the controlled object is better described as a switchable microscopy light source rather than a laser.

registry.description: Pretend we're a laser so that we can re-use the laser GUI controls
